subject: Finishes that help a workspace feel calm
hook: Home office furniture, finished to feel calm
gbp:
Working from home is easier when the room helps you concentrate. SUPERIO Furniture designs and builds fitted home office furniture for homes in Stoke-on-Trent and across Staffordshire, with finishes chosen to keep the space calm.

Who it's for: anyone working from a spare room, box room, loft or the corner of a living space who wants storage that fits properly and a desk that suits the way they work.

What's included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation, where we bring samples so you can see matt, super matt and wood-effect finishes in your own daylight and lamp light
- Measuring and an itemised quote with transparent pricing and no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, with colour-matched ABS edging and soft-close hardware as standard
- Delivery and installation by our own team

We'll help you keep the palette simple, put screens away from reflective surfaces and give the clutter somewhere to live behind doors.

Book a design consultation to talk through your room.
